ownerDecision: Q-HE2B-2 = (a) "HE-003 owns both" (2026-10-13, owner via the lane monitor, verbatim): HE-003 owns the real 10-second I07 write timer and the I07 apiserver HTTP/TLS client; HE-002B owns only the logical expiry (the TIMEOUT event, its abort record, HELD and the IO_AMBIGUOUS answer, as in T59/T61/T62). Record it in HE-002B's design and PR now; amend the W03 plan's obligation register in the next harness-onion meta packet that touches the plan (like EDGE-2); no extra packet now.
ownerDecisions: Q-HE2S-3 = (a) (2026-10-13, owner via the lane monitor, verbatim): HE-002S does the source re-check of the Rust 1.99.0 std paths the gate uses after the seal, recorded in MODEL_DEFINED with source lines; the Linux trace stays with T04.

Q-HE2S-4 = (a) (2026-10-13, owner via the lane monitor, verbatim): two-stage seal. Stage 1 before any input: core limit 0/0 with read-back, PR_SET_DUMPABLE 0, ambient cleared, bounding set and capset down to {CAP_SETPCAP, CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE}. Between stages, only the signed configuration's read and check. Stage 2: drop to {kept}, no_new_privs, then the filter.

Q-HE2S-5 = (a) (2026-10-13, owner via the lane monitor, verbatim): the seal checks "Threads: 1" in /proc/self/status before stage 1, with a reviewed start-up-lint exception limited to gate-sys's seal.rs and that one path; HE-003's source check and T04's per-thread checks stay.

Q-HE2S-7 = (a) "Keep gate dumpable" (2026-10-13, owner via the lane monitor, verbatim): drop the PR_SET_DUMPABLE 0 step (amends Q-HE2S-4 (a)); keep the core limit at 0/0 with read-back. Carry to HE-008: core_pattern is not a pipe, or its helper honours RLIMIT_CORE 0. Carry to T04: a seccomp kill and a panic leave no core anywhere, and the broker's and inspector's reads of the gate succeed.

Q-HE2S-8 = (a) (2026-10-13, owner via the lane monitor, verbatim): move no_new_privs into stage 1, and repeat the "Threads: 1" check at the start of stage 2; HE-003's source check also covers the code between the stages.

Amendment scope = yes (2026-10-13, owner via the lane monitor, verbatim): add SEC-4 and HI-7 (+HE-003 call site, +HE-008 uid, unit start state and SELinux self-permissions) and SEC-QW4 (+HE-002S steady-state re-check) to W03-PLAN-AMEND-1 in slot 232, then one more light contract review round before adoption.
